raw_meta_yaml:
schema_version: 1

context:
  version: "2019.1.0"
  mpi_prefix: ${{ "mpi_" + mpi }}

recipe:
  name: fenics-pkgs
  version: ${{ version }}

source:
  - url: https://bitbucket.org/fenics-project/dolfin/downloads/dolfin-${{ version }}.post0.tar.gz
    sha256: 61abdcdb13684ba2a3ba4afb7ea6c7907aa0896a46439d3af7e8848483d4392f
    patches:
      - boost.patch
      - if: linux
        then: linuxboost.patch
      - find-petsc-slepc.patch
      - hdf5-1.12.patch
      - fix-xdmf.patch
      - python-cmake-args.patch
      - boost-1.86.patch
      - numpy-2.0.patch
      - unpin-pybind.patch
      - c++14.patch
      - petsc-3.25.patch
      - pybind11-3.1-overload-dispatch.patch


build:
  # this doesn't actually affect the build hashes
  # so duplicate where the build hash should actually change
  number: 66
  skip: win
  variant:
    use_keys:
      - python
      - mpi

outputs:
  - package:
      name: fenics-libdolfin
    build:
      skip: win
      script: ${RECIPE_DIR}/build-libdolfin.sh
    requirements:
      build:
        - ${{ compiler('c') }}
        - ${{ stdlib("c") }}
        - ${{ compiler('cxx') }}
        - cmake >=3.9
        - make
        - pkg-config
        - if: mpi == 'openmpi' and build_platform != target_platform
          then: ${{ mpi }}
        # python needed for ufc discovery via ffc
        - if: build_platform != target_platform
          then: python
        - if: build_platform != target_platform
          then: cross-python_${{ target_platform }}
        - if: build_platform != target_platform
          then: numpy
        - if: build_platform != target_platform
          then: fenics-ffc ==${{ version }}
      host:
        - libblas
        - libcblas
        - libboost-devel
        - eigen >=3,<4
        - parmetis
        - if: target_platform != "osx-arm64"
          then: libptscotch
        - suitesparse
        - zlib
        - ${{ mpi }}
        - petsc
        - slepc
        - python
        - numpy
        - fenics-ffc ==${{ version }}
        # need to list libnetcdf and netcdf-fortran twice to get version
        # pinning from conda_build_config and build pinning from {{ mpi_prefix }}
        - hdf5
        - hdf5 * ${{ mpi_prefix }}_*
      run:
        # only need library dependencies that _lack_ run_exports here
        - eigen >=3,<4
        - parmetis
      ignore_run_exports:
        from_package:
          - python
          - numpy
          - cross-python_${{ target_platform }}
    tests:
      - script:
          - test -f ${PREFIX}/lib/libdolfin${SHLIB_EXT}
          - if: osx
            then: test -f ${PREFIX}/lib/libdolfin.${{ version }}${SHLIB_EXT}
          - if: linux
            then: test -f ${PREFIX}/lib/libdolfin${SHLIB_EXT}.${{ version }}
  - package:
      name: fenics-dolfin
    build:
      script: ${RECIPE_DIR}/build-dolfin.sh
    requirements:
      build:
        - ${{ compiler('c') }}
        - ${{ stdlib("c") }}
        - ${{ compiler('cxx') }}
        - cmake >=3.9
        - make
        - pkg-config
        - if: build_platform != target_platform
          then: python
        - if: build_platform != target_platform
          then: cross-python_${{ target_platform }}
        - if: build_platform != target_platform
          then: pybind11
        - if: mpi == 'openmpi' and build_platform != target_platform
          then: ${{ mpi }}
      host:
        - libblas
        - libcblas
        - libboost-devel
        - python
        - pip
        - setuptools
        - pkgconfig
        - zlib
        - ${{ mpi }}
        - mpi4py
        - petsc4py
        - slepc4py
        - numpy
        - pybind11
        - six
        - sympy >=1
        - ${{ pin_subpackage("fenics-libdolfin", exact=True) }}
        - fenics-dijitso ==${{ version }}
        - fenics-fiat ==${{ version }}
        - fenics-ufl ==${{ version }}
        - fenics-ffc ==${{ version }}
        # need to list libnetcdf and netcdf-fortran twice to get version
        # pinning from conda_build_config and build pinning from {{ mpi_prefix }}
        - hdf5
        - hdf5 * ${{ mpi_prefix }}_*
      run:
        - ${{ compiler('cxx') }}
        # gxx provides default 'c++' executable on linux
        - if: linux
          then: gxx
        - python
        # dolfin depends on the boost headers for its own headers, see
        # https://bitbucket.org/fenics-project/dolfin/src/master/dolfin/parameter/Parameters.h#lines-24
        - libboost-headers
        - setuptools
        - zlib
        - ${{ pin_compatible('mpi4py', upper_bound='x') }}
        - petsc4py
        - slepc4py
        - pkgconfig  # Python pkgconfig package
        - pybind11
        - six
        - sympy >=1
        - ${{ pin_subpackage("fenics-libdolfin", exact=True) }}
        - fenics-dijitso ==${{ version }}
        - fenics-fiat ==${{ version }}
        - fenics-ufl ==${{ version }}
        - fenics-ffc ==${{ version }}
    tests:
      - files:
          source:
            - python/test
          recipe:
            - test-dolfin.sh
        requirements:
          run:
            - pip
            - nose
            - pytest
            - git
            - decorator
        script:
          - pip check
          - bash test-dolfin.sh
  - package:
      name: fenics
    build:
      skip: win
      script: echo 1
      variant:
        use_keys:
          - mpi
          - python
    requirements:
      build: []
      host: []
      run:
        - python
        - ${{ pin_subpackage("fenics-libdolfin", exact=True) }}
        - ${{ pin_subpackage("fenics-dolfin", exact=True) }}
    tests:
      - script:
          - bash test-fenics.sh
        files:
          recipe:
            - test-fenics.sh
